browser_selection.reference_role: rir from the fixed-SNR manifest; SNR changes the mixture, not the reference RIR

four_mic_demo_selection.inference_note: Use two passes for a two-channel model, then merge the four output paths.

inference.path: direct RIR estimator -> saved RIR; no MINT inverse, speech reconstruction, or acoustic speech scoring

outputs: two passes merged to four channels

scoring.npm: Rec-BIR/scripts/evaluate_variable_mspacing_bci.py:npm_db, first 16000 samples, shared +/-256 sample lag, global scale-invariant projection error
scoring.acoustic: sure-evaluation RIR bundle, 1 s window, per-channel RT30/RT60/DRR/C50/C80/EDC
scoring.spatial_phase_level: IPD/ILD are computed on the two-channel 1 s RIR FFT ratio relative to channel 0; IPD is circular phase error in radians and ILD is magnitude-ratio error in dB
scoring.waveform_display: Rec-BIR/scripts/waveform_alignment.py:shared_ch0_peak_crop, 2.5 ms pre-roll, then independent peak normalization per trace
scoring.waveform_mae: mean absolute error after the same crop and peak normalization
scoring.temporal_alignment: display crop only; NPM and saved RIR scores do not apply an extra time shift

frequency_analysis.source: normalized native RIR WAVs from the six direct-estimate branches
frequency_analysis.error: octave-band acoustic parameter MAE; distribution reports median and p25/p75

published_artifact.contains: 60 samples per each of six comparison cases, downsampled normalized traces, scores, and provenance
published_artifact.raw_model_outputs: not committed; kept in the local analysis output root
